item.text:
Built [index.html](/private/tmp/pcd-sbx-codex-gpt-6.2-sol-medium-r2-thbw8b_f/work/index.html), the only file in the working directory.

- Both reference hashes matched. The listed air waypoints total 2,800 centi-tiles, and both vectors require that length.
- The strategy weighs route coverage, flyer pressure, and upgrade value, then prioritizes clustered targets and enemies close to leaking. It averaged **44.90 waves across 20 held-out seeds**. Seed 42 held **44.68 waves**, falling at tick **1807**.
- The board, all enemy and turret models, combat and collapse effects, HUD, playback controls, and synthesized audio are implemented. No systems were simplified.

Tested directly from `file://` in Chromium at 1280×650 and 1920×1080. Verified pixel-identical scene scrubbing, countdown and re-fire, the final hold, and audio event triggering. Frame rate on a discrete GPU remains unmeasured.
